Meta.title: Noor-e-Durood — Send Durood together
Meta.description: Recite Durood Shareef upon the Holy Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and add your count. Everyone's durood adds up to one shared total.

Hero.title: Let us send Durood and Salaam upon the Holy Prophet ﷺ together
Hero.subtitle: However much durood you recite, add it here. Together, every count becomes one light.

Durood.shortTranslation: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him ﷺ and his family.
Durood.ibrahimiTranslation1: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad ﷺ and upon the family of Muhammad ﷺ, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
Durood.ibrahimiTranslation2: O Allah, send barakah upon Muhammad ﷺ and upon the family of Muhammad ﷺ, as You sent barakah upon Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

Footer.dua: May Allah accept the durood of all of us. Ameen
Footer.privacy: No names or personal counts are ever shown to anyone here.
